---
title: "Course notes"
toc: false
---

The notes are the core reference for the course. Each chapter page includes worked examples (try them before opening the solution), interactive figures, short *check your understanding* questions and links to the problems you should attempt next. A printable PDF of each chapter is available from the link on the chapter page.

| Chapter | Topics |
|:--|:--|
| [1 · Preliminaries](ch1.qmd) | Fluid elements, Eulerian and Lagrangian descriptions, material derivative, vorticity, shear stress |
| [2 · Conservation Equations](ch2.qmd) | Continuity, Navier–Stokes and energy equations; conservative form; initial and boundary conditions |
| [3 · Turbulence and Turbulence Modelling](ch3.qmd) | Characteristics of turbulence, the energy cascade, Kolmogorov scales, Reynolds averaging, RANS, eddy-viscosity, $k$–$\varepsilon$ and Reynolds-stress models |
| [4 · Boundary Layers](ch4.qmd) | Boundary-layer equations, Blasius solution, momentum integral equation, turbulent boundary layers and the log law, transition, separation |
